caption: The drawing features a symmetrical arrangement of flora and fauna on a rectangular, black background bordered by wavy red, black, and blue lines. At the center sits a large, pale peach-colored flower with green leaves at its base, flanked on both sides by two red birds facing each other. Surrounding the central motif are numerous stylized flowers in shades of red, pink, yellow, and white, along with various green leaves and swirling vine-like tendrils. The composition is densely packed, filling the space with layered floral and botanical forms. The overall color palette includes vibrant red, yellow, green, peach, and light blue, with accents highlighted by the dark black background and bright red and blue border details. The artwork has a framed, ornamental appearance with decorative, natural elements engrossing the entire scene.
title: Chest Design
